title: Aplica config.json
description: Settings/toggles/target/sources/schedule for an Aplica instance. Shared contract between the engine (plugin) and the desktop app. The candidate's personal data lives in profile.json.

target.description: Target profile and knockouts. Compiled into regexes by the scanners (engine/filters.py).

stack_out.description: name->regex map of stacks that, as the main language, knock the job out.

geo_allow.description: Accepted-location words. Empty = accept any location.

company_block.description: Companies/recruiters to never apply to (name knockout).

language_required_block.description: Regex: a required language that knocks the job out.

home_city.description: The user's city; on-site/hybrid is only accepted here.

ghost_max.description: Ghost-job score (0-100) at or above which a posting is skipped. Default 60.

linkedin_locations.description: LinkedIn search locations, each [location, label] (or a bare string). Default: global + remote.

freehire_queries.description: Override the freehire search terms (default: derived from titles_search).

feed_mode.description: LinkedIn feed. OFF by default (highest account-restriction risk).

im_interested.description: Click 'I'm interested' on the company page (high fit).

email_resume.description: Email the résumé when a recruiter/post asks for it.

email_summary.description: Email the daily summary to the user themselves (summary routine).

sso_google.description: Use 'Continue with Google' on new sites.

create_account.description: Create a new account on sites without SSO.

caps.description: Caps and cadence (anti-detection). Enforced by script, not 'in the head'.

schedule.description: Routine times (HH:MM, 24h) and whether they are on.

resume_variants.description: Résumé variants. The agent attaches the best-matching one per job; falls back to paths.resume.

name.description: Short label stored on each application for the metrics breakdown.

file.description: PDF path (relative to the config dir, or absolute).

keywords.description: Regex matched against the job title + description; most hits wins.

desktop_notifications.description: Show native desktop notifications for new blocks/to-dos/stuck jobs.
